[...recordMechanisms.values()].map((mechanism) => <article class="mechanism-entry"><h3><a href={withBase(`/mechanisms/${mechanism.id}`)}>{mechanism.title}</a></h3><p>{mechanism.summary}</p>{mechanism.worksheet.length > 0 && <ul class="worksheet">{mechanism.worksheet.map((row) => <li><strong>{row.topic}:</strong> {row.claimIds.map((id) => <a href={claimHref(id)}>{id}</a>)}{row.unknown && <span class="muted">{row.unknown}</span>}</li>)}</ul>}{mechanism.unknowns.length > 0 && <p class="muted">Open questions: {mechanism.unknowns.join(" · ")}</p>}</article>) : <p class="muted">No mechanism worksheet is linked to this record. import Layout from "../layouts/Layout.astro";
```astro
import { records } from "../lib/catalog";
import { sourcesByIds } from "../lib/knowledge";
import { withBase } from "../lib/paths";
import type { CatalogRecord } from "../lib/knowledge-types";

const groups: { id: string; title: string; description: string; records: CatalogRecord[] }[] = [
  { id: "native-interfaces", title: "Native & undocumented interfaces", description: "Memory, process, thread and instrumentation contracts. Documentation status applies to the specific interface or selector—not every function in the same family.", records: [] },
  { id: "research-binaries", title: "Binaries & research tooling", description: "Publicly described anti-cheat binaries, analysis targets and research tools. A tool's capabilities do not establish access to a protected game or successful anti-cheat evasion.", records: [] },
  { id: "drivers", title: "Drivers & disclosed samples", description: "Anti-cheat components, dual-use diagnostic drivers and historical vulnerability disclosures. Their different roles and trust boundaries stay separate.", records: [] },
];
for (const record of records) {
  if (record.tags.includes("dual-use-driver") || record.tags.includes("vulnerable-driver") || record.tags.includes("anti-cheat-driver")) groups[2].records.push(record);
  else if (record.tags.includes("research-binary")) groups[1].records.push(record);
  else if (record.tags.includes("native-api") || record.tags.includes("undocumented-api")) groups[0].records.push(record);
}
const entryCount = groups.reduce((count, group) => count + group.records.length, 0);
const context = (record: CatalogRecord) => {
  if (record.tags.includes("vulnerable-driver")) return "Historical disclosure";
  if (record.tags.includes("anti-cheat-driver")) return "Anti-cheat driver";
  if (record.tags.includes("dual-use-driver")) return "Dual-use research driver";
  if (record.tags.includes("research-binary")) return record.tags.includes("platform-reference") || record.kind === "project" ? "Research tool / plugin" : "Published analysis target";
  if (record.tags.includes("undocumented-api")) return "Undocumented interface / selector";
  if (record.tags.includes("partially-documented-api")) return "Partially documented Native API";
  return "Documented platform interface";
};
```

```astro
import Layout from "../layouts/Layout.astro";
import { posts } from "../lib/research";
import { records } from "../lib/catalog";
import { mechanisms, claims, sources } from "../lib/knowledge";
import { withBase } from "../lib/paths";
const projects = records.filter((entry) => entry.kind === "project");
const sourceClaimIds = new Map<string, Set<string>>();
for (const claim of claims) {
  if (claim.review === "collected" || (claim.kind !== "observation" && claim.kind !== "inference")) continue;
  for (const citation of claim.citations) {
    if (citation.relation !== "supports") continue;
    let ids = sourceClaimIds.get(citation.sourceId);
    if (!ids) {
      ids = new Set<string>();
      sourceClaimIds.set(citation.sourceId, ids);
    }
    ids.add(claim.id);
  }
}
const inspectedSources = sources
  .filter((source) => sourceClaimIds.has(source.id) && source.access === "available" && source.transport !== "index-only")
  .sort((a, b) => a.publisher.localeCompare(b.publisher) || a.title.localeCompare(b.title));
```

```astro
import Layout from "../layouts/Layout.astro";
import { posts } from "../lib/research";
import { corrections, sourceById } from "../lib/knowledge";
import { recordById } from "../lib/catalog";
import { discovery, discoveryChanges, discoveryItems, discoverySources, pendingChanges, trackedRepos, recentDigest } from "../lib/discovery";
import { withBase } from "../lib/paths";

const reviewedPosts = [...posts].sort((a, b) => b.updated.localeCompare(a.updated) || a.title.localeCompare(b.title));
const reviewedCorrections = [...corrections].sort((a, b) => b.date.localeCompare(a.date));
const pending = [...pendingChanges].sort((a, b) => b.date.localeCompare(a.date));
const reviewedChanges = discoveryChanges.filter((change) => change.review === "reviewed").sort((a, b) => b.date.localeCompare(a.date));
const drifting = trackedRepos.filter((repo) => repo.drift || repo.stale || !repo.reviewedCommit || !repo.headSha);
const issues = discoverySources.filter((source) => source.state !== "ok" || source.backfill.state !== "complete");
const sourceByStatusId = new Map(discoverySources.map((source) => [source.id, source]));
const itemById = new Map(discoveryItems.map((item) => [item.id, item]));
const changeById = new Map(discoveryChanges.map((change) => [change.id, change]));
const safeExternal = (value: string | undefined | null) => {
  if (!value) return null;
  try {
    const url = new URL(value);
    return url.protocol === "http:" || url.protocol === "https:" ? url.href : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
};
const dateLabel = (value: string | null) => {
  if (!value || Number.isNaN(Date.parse(value))) return "Not recorded";
  const date = new Date(value);
  return /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(value)
    ? date.toISOString().slice(0, 10)
    : `${date.toISOString().slice(0, 16).replace("T", " ")} UTC`;
};
const sourceState = { ok: "Reachable", blocked: "Blocked", error: "Fetch failed", pending: "Not yet collected" } as const;
const backfillState = { pending: "Pending", partial: "Partial", complete: "Complete", blocked: "Blocked" } as const;
const shortSha = (sha: string | null) => sha ? sha.slice(0, 12) : "Not recorded";
```

`src/pages/updates.xml.ts`:

```ts
import type { APIRoute } from "astro";
import { corrections } from "../lib/knowledge";
import { posts } from "../lib/research";
import { discovery, discoverySources, discoveryChanges } from "../lib/discovery";
import { feedXml, type FeedEntry } from "../lib/rss";

/** Substantive reference changes: corrections, editorial revisions and reviewed/pending source changes. */
export const GET: APIRoute = ({ site }) => {
  const nameOf = new Map(discoverySources.map((source) => [source.id, source.name]));
  const entries: FeedEntry[] = [
    ...corrections.map((correction) => ({
      title: `${correction.kind === "dispute" ? "Dispute" : "Correction"}: ${correction.title}`,
      path: `/updates#correction-${correction.id}`,
      date: correction.date,
      summary: `${correction.summary} Status: ${correction.status}. Before: ${correction.before} After: ${correction.after}`,
      category: `${correction.kind} (${correction.status})`,
    })),
    ...posts.map((post) => ({
      title: `Note: ${post.title}`,
      path: `/blog/${post.id}`,
      date: post.updated,
      summary: post.summary,
      category: "editorial note",
    })),
    ...discoveryChanges.map((change) => ({
      title: `Source change: ${nameOf.get(change.sourceId) ?? change.sourceId}`,
      path: `/updates#change-${change.id}`,
      date: change.date,
      summary: `${change.summary} Review: ${change.review}. Added ${change.diff.added.length}, removed ${change.diff.removed.length} tracked line(s). A pending change does not modify any claim or reviewed commit.`,
      category: `source change (${change.review})`,
    })),
  ].sort((a, b) => b.date.localeCompare(a.date));
  return new Response(
    feedXml(site?.origin, {
      title: "Anti-Cheat Observatory — updates",
      description: `Corrections, editorial revisions and external source changes. Snapshot ${discovery.syncedAt}.`,
      path: "/updates.xml",
    }, entries),
    { headers: { "Content-Type": "application/rss+xml; charset=utf-8" } },
  );
};

```

```ts
export {};

const input = document.querySelector<HTMLInputElement>("#post-search")!;
const product = document.querySelector<HTMLSelectElement>("#post-product")!;
const provenance = document.querySelector<HTMLSelectElement>("#post-provenance")!;
const categories = [
  ...document.querySelectorAll<HTMLButtonElement>("[data-post-category]"),
];
const cards = [
  ...document.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>("[data-post]"),
].map((element) => ({
  element,
  category: element.dataset.category!,
  products: JSON.parse(element.dataset.products!) as string[],
  provenances: JSON.parse(element.dataset.provenances!) as string[],
  text: element.dataset.search!,
}));
const count = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>("#post-count")!;
const empty = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>("#post-empty")!;
const reset = document.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>("#post-reset")!;
let category = "";
function updateBlog(writeUrl = true) {
  const tokens = input.value
    .normalize("NFKC")
    .toLocaleLowerCase("en")
    .trim()
    .split(/\s+/)
    .filter(Boolean);
  let visible = 0;
  for (const card of cards) {
    const matches =
      (!category || card.category === category) &&
      (!product.value || card.products.includes(product.value)) &&
      (!provenance.value || card.provenances.includes(provenance.value)) &&
      tokens.every((token) => card.text.includes(token));
    card.element.hidden = !matches;
    if (matches) visible++;
  }
  for (const button of categories) {
    const selected = button.dataset.postCategory === category;
    button.classList.toggle("active", selected);
    button.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(selected));
  }
  count.textContent = `${visible} of ${cards.length} research notes`;
  empty.hidden = visible !== 0;
  reset.hidden = !category && !product.value && !provenance.value && !input.value;
  if (writeUrl) {
    const query = new URLSearchParams();
    if (category) query.set("category", category);
    if (product.value) query.set("product", product.value);
    if (provenance.value) query.set("provenance", provenance.value);
    if (input.value.trim()) query.set("q", input.value.trim());
    history.replaceState(
      null,
      "",
      `${location.pathname}${query.size ? `?${query}` : ""}${location.hash}`,
    );
  }
}
function loadBlogQuery() {
  const query = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
  const requestedCategory = query.get("category") ?? "";
  category = categories.some(
    (button) => button.dataset.postCategory === requestedCategory,
  )
    ? requestedCategory
    : "";
  for (const [select, key] of [
    [product, "product"],
    [provenance, "provenance"],
  ] as const) {
    const value = query.get(key) ?? "";
    select.value = [...select.options].some((option) => option.value === value)
      ? value
      : "";
  }
  input.value = query.get("q") ?? "";
  updateBlog(false);
}
function clearBlog() {
  category = "";
  input.value = "";
  product.value = "";
  provenance.value = "";
  updateBlog();
}
input.addEventListener("input", () => updateBlog());
product.addEventListener("change", () => updateBlog());
provenance.addEventListener("change", () => updateBlog());
for (const button of categories)
  button.addEventListener("click", () => {
    category = button.dataset.postCategory!;
    updateBlog();
  });
reset.addEventListener("click", clearBlog);
document
  .querySelector("#post-empty-reset")
  ?.addEventListener("click", clearBlog);
window.addEventListener("popstate", loadBlogQuery);
loadBlogQuery();
```

`src/scripts/catalog.ts`:

```ts
import { withBase } from "../lib/paths";

interface PagefindPage { url: string; excerpt?: string; meta?: { title?: string }; }
interface PagefindResult { data(): Promise<PagefindPage> }
interface PagefindResponse { results: PagefindResult[]; unfilteredResultCount?: number }
interface PagefindModule {
  options(options: { baseUrl: string; basePath: string; noWorker: boolean }): Promise<void>;
  search(query: string, options?: { filters?: Record<string, string> }): Promise<PagefindResponse>;
}
const form = document.querySelector<HTMLFormElement>("#catalog-filters");
if (form) {
  const search = form.querySelector<HTMLInputElement>("#catalog-search")!;
  const selects = [...form.querySelectorAll<HTMLSelectElement>("select")];
  const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll<HTMLTableRowElement>("tr[data-record]")];
  const count = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>("#results-count")!;
  const empty = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>("#empty-state")!;
  const fulltext = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>("#fulltext-results")!;
  const status = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>("#fulltext-status")!;
  const results = document.querySelector<HTMLOListElement>("#fulltext-list")!;
  const more = document.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>("#fulltext-more")!;
  let index: Promise<PagefindModule> | undefined;
  let revision = 0;
  let timer: number | undefined;
  let found: PagefindResult[] = [];
  let shown = 0;
  const pagefindPath = withBase("/pagefind/pagefind.js");
  function updateUrl() {
    const parameters = new URLSearchParams();
    if (search.value.trim()) parameters.set("q", search.value.trim());
    for (const select of selects) if (select.value) parameters.set(select.name, select.value);
    history.replaceState(null, "", `${location.pathname}${parameters.size ? `?${parameters}` : ""}${location.hash}`);
  }
  function filterRows() {
    const selection = Object.fromEntries(selects.map((element) => [element.name, element.value]));
    const tokens = search.value.trim().normalize("NFKC").toLocaleLowerCase("en").split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
    let visible = 0;
    for (const row of rows) {
      const matches = (!selection.kind || row.dataset.kind === selection.kind) &&
        (!selection.vendor || row.dataset.vendor === selection.vendor) &&
        (!selection.platform || (JSON.parse(row.dataset.platforms ?? "[]") as string[]).includes(selection.platform)) &&
        (!selection.layer || (JSON.parse(row.dataset.layers ?? "[]") as string[]).includes(selection.layer)) &&
        (!selection.historical || row.dataset.historical === String(selection.historical === "yes")) &&
        (!selection.state || (JSON.parse(row.dataset.states ?? "[]") as string[]).includes(selection.state)) &&
        tokens.every((token) => row.dataset.search?.includes(token));
      row.hidden = !matches;
      if (matches) visible++;
    }
    count.textContent = `Showing ${visible} of ${rows.length} records${tokens.length ? " in the metadata table" : ""}`;
    empty.hidden = visible !== 0;
  }
  async function showMore(current: number) {
    const next = found.slice(shown, shown + 12);
    const resolved = await Promise.allSettled(next.map((item) => item.data()));
    if (revision !== current) return;
    for (const entry of resolved) {
      if (entry.status === "rejected") { status.textContent = "Some indexed matches could not be loaded; try another search."; continue; }
      const page = entry.value;
      let url: URL;
      try { url = new URL(page.url, location.href); } catch { continue; }
      if (url.origin !== location.origin) continue;
      if (!url.pathname.startsWith(withBase("/"))) {
        if (!page.url.startsWith("/")) continue;
        url = new URL(`${withBase(url.pathname)}${url.search}${url.hash}`, location.origin);
      }
      if (url.pathname !== withBase("/")) url.pathname = url.pathname.replace(/\/+$/, "") || "/";
      const li = document.createElement("li");
      li.className = "panel";
      const link = document.createElement("a");
      link.href = url.href;
      link.textContent = page.meta?.title || url.pathname.split("/").filter(Boolean).pop() || "Indexed page";
      const excerpt = document.createElement("p");
      excerpt.className = "muted small";
      // Pagefind excerpts contain <mark> markup. Parse into inert DOM and use text only.
      excerpt.textContent = new DOMParser().parseFromString(page.excerpt ?? "", "text/html").body.textContent ?? "";
      li.append(link, excerpt);
      results.append(li);
    }
    shown += next.length;
    more.hidden = shown >= found.length;
    if (!results.children.length && shown >= found.length) status.textContent = "No readable indexed results for this search.";
  }
  async function queryIndex() {
    const current = ++revision;
    const query = search.value.trim();
    fulltext.hidden = !query;
    results.replaceChildren();
    more.hidden = true;
    shown = 0;
    found = [];
    if (!query) { status.textContent = ""; return; }
    status.textContent = "Searching the static full-text index…";
    try {
      // Pagefind is generated after Astro's build, not bundled by Vite.
      index ??= (import(/* @vite-ignore */ pagefindPath) as Promise<PagefindModule>).then(async (module) => {
        // Pagefind's relative metadata URLs fail in the observed blob-worker context.
        // Its supported main-thread mode uses the same generated WASM index.
        await module.options({ noWorker: true, baseUrl: withBase("/"), basePath: new URL(withBase("/pagefind/"), location.origin).href });
        return module;
      });
      const pagefind = await index;
      const selection = Object.fromEntries(selects.map((element) => [element.name, element.value]));
      const filters = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(selection).filter(([, value]) => value));
      const response = await pagefind.search(query, Object.keys(filters).length ? { filters } : undefined);
      if (current !== revision) return;
      found = response.results;
      status.textContent = `${found.length} indexed ${found.length === 1 ? "page" : "pages"} match this search${Object.keys(filters).length ? " and filters" : ""}.`;
      if (found.length) await showMore(current);
    } catch (cause) {
      if (current !== revision) return;
      index = undefined;
      status.textContent = `Full-text index unavailable. ${cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : "Could not load Pagefind."} Metadata filtering above still works.`;
    }
  }
  function refresh(writeUrl = true) {
    filterRows();
    if (writeUrl) updateUrl();
    clearTimeout(timer);
    timer = setTimeout(() => { void queryIndex(); }, 200);
  }
  function readUrl() {
    const parameters = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
    search.value = parameters.get("q") ?? "";
    for (const select of selects) {
      const value = parameters.get(select.name) ?? "";
      select.value = [...select.options].some((option) => option.value === value) ? value : "";
    }
    refresh(false);
  }
  search.addEventListener("input", () => refresh());
  form.addEventListener("change", () => refresh());
  form.addEventListener("submit", (event) => { event.preventDefault(); refresh(); fulltext.scrollIntoView({ block: "nearest", behavior: matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches ? "auto" : "smooth" }); });
  document.querySelector("#reset-filters")?.addEventListener("click", () => { form.reset(); refresh(); });
  more.addEventListener("click", () => { void showMore(revision); });
  window.addEventListener("popstate", readUrl);
  readUrl();
}
```

```ts
import { loadKnowledge } from "./knowledge-client";
import { withBase } from "../lib/paths";

const form = document.querySelector<HTMLFormElement>("#compare-controls");
const results = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>("#comparison-results");
async function initialize() {
  if (!form || !results) return;
  const { records, claims, mechanisms, builds, sources } = await loadKnowledge();
  const systems = records.filter((record) => record.kind === "product");
  if (!systems.length) { results.textContent = "No system dossiers are published."; return; }
  const systemSelect = (side: string) => form.elements.namedItem(side) as HTMLSelectElement;
  const buildSelect = (side: string) => form.elements.namedItem(`build${side.toUpperCase()}`) as HTMLSelectElement;
  const text = (tag: string, value: string, className?: string) => {
    const node = document.createElement(tag); node.textContent = value; if (className) node.className = className; return node;
  };
  const link = (path: string, label: string) => {
    const node = document.createElement("a"); node.href = withBase(path); node.textContent = label; return node;
  };
  function updateBuilds(side: string, preferred = "") {
    const system = systemSelect(side).value; const select = buildSelect(side);
    const candidates = builds.filter((build) => build.systemIds.includes(system));
    select.replaceChildren(new Option("No selected build (scope unknown unless specified)", ""), ...candidates.map((build) => new Option(`${build.label} · ${build.version ?? "unknown version"}`, build.id)));
    select.value = candidates.some((item) => item.id === preferred) ? preferred : "";
  }
  function panel(side: string) {
    const id = systemSelect(side).value;
    const buildId = buildSelect(side).value;
    const system = systems.find((item) => item.id === id);
    const section = document.createElement("section"); section.className = "panel compare-column";
    section.append(text("h2", system?.title ?? id));
    const scope = document.createElement("p");
    scope.append("Build scope: ", buildId ? link(`/builds/${buildId}`, builds.find((item) => item.id === buildId)?.label ?? buildId) : "No build selected. Unscoped claims are shown separately, never as current build facts.");
    section.append(scope);
    const candidates = mechanisms.filter((mechanism) => mechanism.systemIds.includes(id));
    section.append(text("h3", "Documented mechanism worksheets"));
    if (!candidates.length) section.append(text("p", "Unknown: no mechanism worksheet documented for this system."));
    for (const mechanism of candidates) {
      const wrapper = document.createElement("div"); wrapper.append(link(`/mechanisms/${mechanism.id}`, mechanism.title));
      const evidence = mechanism.claimIds.map((claimId) => claims.find((claim) => claim.id === claimId)).filter((claim) => claim && claim.systemIds.includes(id) && (buildId ? claim.buildIds.includes(buildId) : true));
      wrapper.append(text("p", `${evidence.length} explicitly ${buildId ? "selected-build" : "system"}-scoped linked claim(s). ${mechanism.unknowns.length ? `Unknown: ${mechanism.unknowns.join("; ")}` : "No additional unknowns recorded."}`));
      if (!evidence.length) wrapper.append(text("p", "Unknown for selected scope; a generic mechanism description is not implementation evidence."));
      section.append(wrapper);
    }
    const applicable = claims.filter((claim) => claim.systemIds.includes(id) && (buildId ? claim.buildIds.includes(buildId) : claim.buildIds.length > 0));
    section.append(text("h3", buildId ? "Claims tied to the selected build" : "Claims tied to identified builds (not current-build claims)"));
    if (!applicable.length) section.append(text("p", "Unknown: no claim explicitly tied to this scope."));
    for (const claim of applicable) {
      const article = document.createElement("article"); article.className = "compare-claim";
      article.append(link(`/claims/${claim.id}`, claim.statement));
      article.append(text("p", `State: ${claim.state}; review: ${claim.review}; ${claim.applicability}. ${claim.buildIds.map((id) => builds.find((build) => build.id === id)?.label ?? id).join(", ")}.`));
      const cites = document.createElement("p"); cites.append("Evidence: ");
      for (const citation of claim.citations) { cites.append(link(`/sources/${citation.sourceId}`, `${sources.find((source) => source.id === citation.sourceId)?.title ?? citation.sourceId} [${citation.locator.kind}: ${citation.locator.value}]`), " "); }
      article.append(cites); section.append(article);
    }
    const unknown = claims.filter((claim) => claim.systemIds.includes(id) && !claim.buildIds.length);
    section.append(text("h3", `Build-unscoped claims (${unknown.length}) · not selected-build observations`));
    if (!unknown.length) section.append(text("p", "No build-unscoped claims recorded; other build gaps may remain."));
    for (const claim of unknown) { const paragraph = document.createElement("p"); paragraph.append(link(`/claims/${claim.id}`, claim.statement), ` · ${claim.state} · ${claim.applicability}`); section.append(paragraph); }
    return section;
  }
  function render() {
    const params = new URLSearchParams({ a: systemSelect("a").value, b: systemSelect("b").value });
    for (const side of ["a", "b"]) if (buildSelect(side).value) params.set(`build${side.toUpperCase()}`, buildSelect(side).value);
    history.replaceState(null, "", `${location.pathname}?${params}${location.hash}`);
    results!.replaceChildren(panel("a"), panel("b"));
    results!.className = "comparison-grid";
  }
  const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
  for (const [index, side] of ["a", "b"].entries()) {
    const requested = params.get(side);
    systemSelect(side).value = systems.some((item) => item.id === requested) ? requested! : systems[index % systems.length].id;
    updateBuilds(side, params.get(`build${side.toUpperCase()}`) ?? "");
    systemSelect(side).addEventListener("change", () => { updateBuilds(side); render(); });
    buildSelect(side).addEventListener("change", render);
  }
  form.addEventListener("submit", (event) => { event.preventDefault(); render(); });
  render();
}
void initialize().catch((error) => {
  if (results) results.textContent = `Comparison data unavailable: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}`;
});
```

`src/scripts/knowledge-client.ts`:

```ts
import { withBase } from "../lib/paths";
import type { KnowledgeDataset } from "../lib/knowledge-types";
import type { DiscoverySnapshot } from "../lib/discovery";

let knowledge: Promise<KnowledgeDataset> | undefined;
let discovery: Promise<DiscoverySnapshot> | undefined;
async function dataset<T extends { schemaVersion: string }>(path: string): Promise<T> {
  const response = await fetch(withBase(path));
  if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Research data unavailable (HTTP ${response.status})`);
  const value = await response.json() as T;
  if (value.schemaVersion !== "2.0.0") throw new Error("Unsupported research dataset version; reload the published site.");
  return value;
}
/** Content stays in the validated static JSON export, not duplicated in every browser bundle. */
export function loadKnowledge(): Promise<KnowledgeDataset> {
  return knowledge ??= dataset<KnowledgeDataset>("/api/v2/knowledge.json").catch((error) => { knowledge = undefined; throw error; });
}
export function loadDiscovery(): Promise<DiscoverySnapshot> {
  return discovery ??= dataset<DiscoverySnapshot>("/api/v2/discovery.json").catch((error) => { discovery = undefined; throw error; });
}
```

```ts
import { loadKnowledge, loadDiscovery } from "./knowledge-client";
import { withBase } from "../lib/paths";
import type { Correction } from "../lib/knowledge-types";
import type { SourceChange } from "../lib/discovery";

type BookmarkType = "record" | "claim" | "source" | "mechanism";
type Bookmark = { type: BookmarkType; id: string; title: string; url: string };
type SavedQuery = { name: string; url: string };
type Watch = { id: string; title: string };
type Library = { schemaVersion: "1.0.0"; bookmarks: Bookmark[]; queries: SavedQuery[]; watches: Watch[] };
const key = "aco-library-v1";
const empty = (): Library => ({ schemaVersion: "1.0.0", bookmarks: [], queries: [], watches: [] });
const known: Record<BookmarkType, Map<string, { title: string; url: string }>> = {
  record: new Map(), claim: new Map(), source: new Map(), mechanism: new Map(),
};
const watchable = new Map<string, string>();
const claimsByEntity = new Map<string, Set<string>>();
let corrections: Correction[] = [];
let discoveryChanges: SourceChange[] = [];
let loaded: Promise<void> | undefined;
function loadCatalog(): Promise<void> {
  if (!loaded) loaded = Promise.all([loadKnowledge(), loadDiscovery()]).then(([knowledge, discovery]) => {
    for (const item of knowledge.records) { known.record.set(item.id, { title: item.title, url: withBase(`/records/${item.id}`) }); watchable.set(item.id, item.title); }
    const originSources = new Map<string, string[]>(), sourceOrigins = new Map<string, string>();
    for (const item of knowledge.sources) {
      known.source.set(item.id, { title: item.title, url: withBase(`/sources/${item.id}`) }); watchable.set(item.id, item.title);
      sourceOrigins.set(item.id, item.originId);
      const group = originSources.get(item.originId) ?? []; group.push(item.id); originSources.set(item.originId, group);
    }
    for (const item of knowledge.claims) {
      const label = item.statement.length > 300 ? `${item.statement.slice(0, 299)}…` : item.statement;
      known.claim.set(item.id, { title: label, url: withBase(`/claims/${item.id}`) }); watchable.set(item.id, label);
      const scope = new Set([...item.systemIds, ...item.recordIds, ...item.citations.flatMap((citation) => originSources.get(sourceOrigins.get(citation.sourceId) ?? "") ?? [citation.sourceId])]);
      for (const id of scope) {
        if (!claimsByEntity.has(id)) claimsByEntity.set(id, new Set());
        claimsByEntity.get(id)!.add(item.id);
      }
    }
    for (const item of knowledge.mechanisms) known.mechanism.set(item.id, { title: item.title, url: withBase(`/mechanisms/${item.id}`) });
    corrections = knowledge.corrections; discoveryChanges = discovery.changes;
  }).catch((error) => { loaded = undefined; throw error; });
  return loaded;
}
function safeQuery(url: string): boolean {
  if (typeof url !== "string" || url.length > 2048 || /[\u0000-\u001f\\]/.test(url) || url.includes("#")) return false;
  try {
    const parsed = new URL(url, location.origin);
    const base = withBase("/");
    return parsed.origin === location.origin && url.startsWith(base) && parsed.pathname.startsWith(base) && !parsed.pathname.includes("..") && ["/", "/catalog", "/research", "/projects", "/feed", "/compare", "/relationships", "/library"].some((route) => parsed.pathname === withBase(route) || parsed.pathname === `${withBase(route).replace(/\/$/, "")}/`);
  } catch { return false; }
}
function parseLibrary(input: unknown): Library {
  if (!input || typeof input !== "object" || Array.isArray(input)) throw Error("Expected a library object.");
  const data = input as Record<string, unknown>;
  if (data.schemaVersion !== "1.0.0" || !Array.isArray(data.bookmarks) || !Array.isArray(data.queries) || !Array.isArray(data.watches)) throw Error("Unsupported or incomplete library schema version.");
  if (data.bookmarks.length > 500 || data.queries.length > 200 || data.watches.length > 500) throw Error("Backup exceeds local library limits.");
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  for (const item of data.bookmarks) {
    if (!item || typeof item !== "object" || !Object.hasOwn(known, item.type)) throw Error("Unknown bookmark type.");
    const entry = known[item.type as BookmarkType].get(item.id);
    if (!entry || item.url !== entry.url || typeof item.title !== "string" || !item.title.trim() || item.title.length > 300 || seen.has(`${item.type}:${item.id}`)) throw Error("Bookmark has an unknown ID, invalid local URL or duplicate entry.");
    seen.add(`${item.type}:${item.id}`);
  }
  seen.clear();
  for (const item of data.queries) {
    if (!item || typeof item.name !== "string" || !item.name.trim() || item.name.length > 120 || !safeQuery(item.url) || seen.has(item.url)) throw Error("Saved query has an invalid name, URL or duplicate entry.");
    seen.add(item.url);
  }
  seen.clear();
  for (const item of data.watches) {
    if (!item || !watchable.has(item.id) || typeof item.title !== "string" || !item.title.trim() || item.title.length > 300 || seen.has(item.id)) throw Error("Watch has an unknown ID or duplicate entry.");
    seen.add(item.id);
  }
  return input as Library;
}
let available = false;
let library = empty();
let stored: string | null = null;
try {

  localStorage.setItem(probe, "ok"); localStorage.removeItem(probe);
  stored = localStorage.getItem(key);
  available = true;
} catch (error) { console.warn("Local library storage unavailable:", error); }
const startup = available && (stored || document.querySelector("#library-watches"))

    .catch((error) => { available = false; console.warn("Local library unavailable or invalid:", error); })
  : Promise.resolve();
function status(message: string) { const node = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>("#library-status"); if (node) node.textContent = message; }
function persist() {
  if (!available) { status("Browser storage is denied or unavailable. Nothing was saved; enable site storage to use the library."); return false; }
  try { localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(library)); render(); return true; }
  catch { available = false; status("Browser storage failed (possibly quota or policy). Changes were not saved."); return false; }
}
function buttonState() {
  for (const element of document.querySelectorAll<HTMLButtonElement>("[data-bookmark-id], [data-watch-id]")) {
    const id = element.dataset.bookmarkId ?? element.dataset.watchId!;
    const pressed = element.dataset.bookmarkId ? library.bookmarks.some((item) => item.id === id && item.type === element.dataset.bookmarkType) : library.watches.some((item) => item.id === id);
    element.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(available && pressed));
    element.textContent = element.dataset.bookmarkId ? (pressed && available ? "Saved · remove" : "Save to library") : (pressed && available ? "Watching · remove" : "Watch for changes");
    element.disabled = !available;
    if (!available) element.title = "Browser storage unavailable; saving disabled";
  }
}
function action(label: string, actionName: string, index: number): HTMLButtonElement {
  const button = document.createElement("button"); button.type = "button"; button.dataset.libraryAction = actionName; button.dataset.libraryIndex = String(index); button.textContent = label; return button;
}
function listItem(title: string, url?: string) {
  const item = document.createElement("li");
  if (url) { const anchor = document.createElement("a"); anchor.href = url; anchor.textContent = title; item.append(anchor); }
  else item.append(document.createTextNode(title));
  return item;
}
function render() {
  buttonState();
  const bookmarks = document.querySelector("#library-bookmarks"); const queries = document.querySelector("#library-queries"); const watches = document.querySelector("#library-watches");
  if (!bookmarks || !queries || !watches) return;
  const bookmarkList = document.createElement("ul");
  for (const [index, item] of library.bookmarks.entries()) { const row = listItem(`${item.title} (${item.type})`, item.url); row.append(action("Rename", "rename-bookmark", index), action("Remove", "remove-bookmark", index)); bookmarkList.append(row); }
  bookmarks.replaceChildren(bookmarkList); if (!library.bookmarks.length) bookmarks.textContent = "No saved research yet.";
  const queryList = document.createElement("ul");
  for (const [index, item] of library.queries.entries()) { const row = listItem(item.name, item.url); row.append(action("Rename", "rename-query", index), action("Remove", "remove-query", index)); queryList.append(row); }
  queries.replaceChildren(queryList); if (!library.queries.length) queries.textContent = "No saved queries.";
  const watchList = document.createElement("ul");
  for (const [index, item] of library.watches.entries()) {
    const row = listItem(item.title); row.append(action("Rename", "rename-watch", index), action("Remove watch", "remove-watch", index));
    const watchedClaims = claimsByEntity.get(item.id);
    const matched = corrections.filter((event) => event.recordIds.includes(item.id) || event.claimIds.includes(item.id) || event.sourceIds.includes(item.id) || event.claimIds.some((id) => watchedClaims?.has(id)));
    const changes = discoveryChanges.filter((change) => change.sourceId === item.id || change.recordIds.includes(item.id) || change.claimIds.includes(item.id) || change.claimIds.some((id) => watchedClaims?.has(id)));
    const events = document.createElement("ul");
    for (const event of matched) { const li = listItem(`${event.date} · ${event.kind}: ${event.title}`); for (const id of event.claimIds) { const a = document.createElement("a"); a.href = withBase(`/claims/${id}`); a.textContent = ` Claim ${id}`; li.append(a); } events.append(li); }
    for (const change of changes) { const li = listItem(`${change.date} · source ${change.kind}: ${change.summary}`); const a = document.createElement("a"); a.href = withBase("/feed"); a.textContent = " Review source change"; li.append(a); events.append(li); }
    if (!matched.length && !changes.length) events.append(listItem("No published correction or source change currently matches this ID; no live notifications."));
    row.append(events); watchList.append(row);
  }
  watches.replaceChildren(watchList); if (!library.watches.length) watches.textContent = "No watched entities.";
  status(available ? "Stored only in this browser. Watches match published corrections and discovery source changes; they do not send notifications." : "Browser storage denied or invalid: saving and importing are disabled. Existing research remains readable.");
  const exportButton = document.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>("#library-export"); if (exportButton) exportButton.disabled = !available;
  const input = document.querySelector<HTMLInputElement>("#library-import"); if (input) input.disabled = !available;
}
document.addEventListener("click", async (event) => {
  const target = event.target;
  if (!(target instanceof Element)) return;
  const button = target.closest<HTMLButtonElement>("button[data-bookmark-id],button[data-watch-id],button[data-save-query],button[data-library-action]");

  await startup;
  if (!available) { status("Storage unavailable; nothing was saved."); return; }

  if (!available) { status("Storage unavailable; nothing was saved."); return; }

  if (id) {
    const type = button.dataset.bookmarkType as BookmarkType;
    const knownItem = known[type]?.get(id);

    const index = library.bookmarks.findIndex((item) => item.id === id && item.type === type);
    if (index < 0) library.bookmarks.push({ type, id, title: knownItem.title, url: knownItem.url }); else library.bookmarks.splice(index, 1);
    persist(); return;
  }
  const watch = button.dataset.watchId;

  if (button.hasAttribute("data-save-query")) {
    const url = `${location.pathname}${location.search}`;
    if (!safeQuery(url)) { status("Current URL cannot be saved as a local query."); return; }
    const name = prompt("Name this saved query:"); if (!name) return;
    if (!name.trim() || name.length > 120 || library.queries.some((item) => item.url === url)) { status("Choose a nonempty name under 121 characters and a URL not already saved."); return; }
    library.queries.push({ name: name.trim(), url }); persist(); return;
  }
  const index = Number(button.dataset.libraryIndex);
  if (!Number.isInteger(index) || index < 0) return;
  if (button.dataset.libraryAction === "remove-bookmark" && library.bookmarks[index]) library.bookmarks.splice(index, 1);
  if (button.dataset.libraryAction === "remove-query" && library.queries[index]) library.queries.splice(index, 1);
  if (button.dataset.libraryAction === "remove-watch" && library.watches[index]) library.watches.splice(index, 1);
  if (button.dataset.libraryAction === "rename-bookmark" && library.bookmarks[index]) { const title = prompt("New local bookmark label:", library.bookmarks[index].title); if (title === null) return; if (!title.trim() || title.length > 300) { status("Bookmark label must be nonempty and at most 300 characters."); return; } library.bookmarks[index].title = title.trim(); }
  if (button.dataset.libraryAction === "rename-watch" && library.watches[index]) { const title = prompt("New local watch label:", library.watches[index].title); if (title === null) return; if (!title.trim() || title.length > 300) { status("Watch label must be nonempty and at most 300 characters."); return; } library.watches[index].title = title.trim(); }
  if (button.dataset.libraryAction === "rename-query" && library.queries[index]) { const name = prompt("New saved query name:", library.queries[index].name); if (!name) return; if (!name.trim() || name.length > 120) { status("Name must be nonempty and at most 120 characters."); return; } library.queries[index].name = name.trim(); }
  persist();
});

  input.value = "";
});
```

```ts
function makeSource(values: FormData): KnowledgeSource {
  const kind = value(values, "revisionKind") as KnowledgeSource["revision"]["kind"];
  const source: KnowledgeSource = {

function makeClaim(card: HTMLFieldSetElement, sourceId: string, id: string, productIds: string[], recordIds: string[]): Claim {
  const input = (name: string) => (card.querySelector<HTMLInputElement | HTMLTextAreaElement | HTMLSelectElement>(`[name="${name}"]`)!).value.trim();
  const locator: Citation["locator"] = {
    kind: input("locatorKind") as Citation["locator"]["kind"],
    value: input("locatorValue"),
  };
  if (input("locatorUrl")) locator.url = input("locatorUrl");
  if (input("addressSpace")) locator.addressSpace = input("addressSpace");
  if (input("imageBase")) locator.imageBase = input("imageBase");
  return {
    id: input("claimId"),
    statement: input("statement"),
    recordIds,
    postIds: [id],
    systemIds: productIds,
    buildIds: selected(card, "buildIds"),
    mechanismIds: selected(card, "mechanismIds"),
    kind: input("kind") as Claim["kind"],
    provenance: input("provenance") as Claim["provenance"],
    review: input("review") as Claim["review"],
    state: input("state") as Claim["state"],
    applicability: input("applicability"),
    citations: [{ sourceId, relation: input("relation") as Citation["relation"], locator, evidence: input("evidence") }],
    limitations: lines(input("limitations")),
    reviewedAt: input("reviewedAt"),
    validationIds: [],
    contradicts: [],
    supersedes: [],
  };

function makeProposal(): KnowledgeProposal {
  const values = new FormData(form);
  const id = value(values, "id");
  const source = sourceMode() === "new" ? makeSource(values) : undefined;
  const sourceId = source?.id ?? value(values, "existingSource");
  const productIds = values.getAll("products").map(String);
  const relatedIds = values.getAll("related").map(String);
  const recordIds = [...productIds, ...relatedIds];
  const cards = [...claimList.querySelectorAll<HTMLFieldSetElement>(".claim-card")];
  const claims = cards.map((card) => makeClaim(card, sourceId, id, productIds, recordIds));
  const sections: ResearchPost["sections"] = [];
  for (let index = 0; index < cards.length; index++) {
    const sectionTitle = cards[index].querySelector<HTMLInputElement>('[name="sectionTitle"]')!.value.trim();
    let section = sections.find((item) => item.title === sectionTitle);
    if (!section) {
      section = { title: sectionTitle, claimIds: [] };
      sections.push(section);
    }
    section.claimIds.push(claims[index].id);
  }
  const post: ResearchPost = {
    id,
    title: value(values, "title"),
    summary: value(values, "summary"),
    published: value(values, "published"),
    updated: today,
    category: value(values, "category") as ResearchPost["category"],
    author: "Observatory editorial",
    productIds,
    relatedIds,
    tags: [...new Set(value(values, "tags").split(",").map((tag) => tag.trim()).filter(Boolean))],
    takeaways: lines(value(values, "takeaways")).map((line) => line.replace(/^[-*]\s+/, "")),
    sourceIds: [sourceId],
    sections,
  };
  return { schemaVersion: "2.0.0", ...(source ? { sources: [source] } : {}), claims, posts: [post] };
}

function checkDuplicateDetails(proposal: KnowledgeProposal, existing: KnowledgeDataset): string[] {
  const errors: string[] = [];
  const source = proposal.sources?.[0];
  if (source && existing.sources.some((entry) => entry.url === source.url && entry.revision.kind === source.revision.kind && entry.revision.value === source.revision.value))
    errors.push("This URL and revision already have a source entry. Select the existing source instead.");
  const post = proposal.posts![0];
  if (existing.posts.some((entry) => entry.title.trim().toLowerCase() === post.title.trim().toLowerCase()))
    errors.push("A post with this title already exists. Choose a distinct title or update the existing post in the repository.");
  const existingStatements = new Set(existing.claims.map((claim) => claim.statement.trim().toLowerCase()));
  const statements = new Set<string>();
  for (const claim of proposal.claims ?? []) {
    const statement = claim.statement.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (statements.has(statement) || existingStatements.has(statement))
      errors.push(`Claim ${claim.id} repeats an existing statement. Attribute or revise the existing claim instead.`);
    statements.add(statement);
  }
  return errors;
}

claimList.addEventListener("change", (event) => {
  if (!(event.target instanceof HTMLSelectElement) || event.target.name !== "locatorKind") return;
  const card = event.target.closest<HTMLFieldSetElement>(".claim-card")!;
  card.querySelector<HTMLInputElement>('[name="addressSpace"]')!.required = event.target.value === "function";
});
form.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>("#add-claim")!.addEventListener("click", addClaim);
claimList.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
  if (!(event.target instanceof HTMLElement) || !event.target.closest(".remove-claim")) return;
  event.target.closest(".claim-card")?.remove();
  updateRemoveButtons();
  clearPrepared();
});
addClaim();
if (existingSource.options.length === 1) {
  form.querySelector<HTMLInputElement>('[name="sourceMode"][value="new"]')!.checked = true;
  form.querySelector<HTMLInputElement>('[name="sourceMode"][value="existing"]')!.disabled = true;
}
updateSourceMode();
existingSource.addEventListener("change", syncClaimProvenance);
sourceFields.querySelector<HTMLSelectElement>('[name="sourceProvenance"]')!.addEventListener("change", syncClaimProvenance);

form.addEventListener("submit", async (event) => {
  event.preventDefault();
  clearPrepared();
  error.hidden = true;
  if (!form.reportValidity()) return;
  const proposal = makeProposal();
  if (proposal.claims?.some((claim) => claim.provenance !== sourceProvenance())) {
    showError("Claim evidence provenance must match the selected source. Use claim kind “Inference” for your independent interpretation, not a different source origin.");
    return;
  }
  if (!validate(proposal)) {
    showError(`Schema validation: ${ajv.errorsText(validate.errors, { separator: "; " })}`);
    return;
  }
  const version = draftVersion;
  try {
    const response = await fetch(withBase("/api/v2/knowledge.json"));
    if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}`);
    const existing = await response.json() as KnowledgeDataset;
    if (version !== draftVersion) return;
    const errors = [...proposalErrors(proposal, existing), ...checkDuplicateDetails(proposal, existing)];
    if (errors.length) {
      showError(errors.join(" "));
      return;
    }
    generated = `${JSON.stringify(proposal, null, 2)}\n`;
    output.value = generated;
    objectUrl = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([generated], { type: "application/json" }));
    download.href = objectUrl;
    download.download = "proposal.json";
    status.textContent = "Schema and local dataset checks passed. Import into your checkout for final validation; no files were published here.";
    result.hidden = false;
    result.scrollIntoView({ behavior: window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches ? "auto" : "smooth" });
  } catch (cause) {
    if (version === draftVersion) showError(`Unable to check current dataset: ${cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : String(cause)}. No proposal was prepared.`);
  }
});

document.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>("#copy-proposal")!.addEventListener("click", async () => {
  if (!generated) return;
  const text = generated;
  try {
    await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    if (text === generated) status.textContent = "Proposal JSON copied. Save it as proposal.json, then run npm run import -- proposal.json locally.";
  } catch {
    if (text !== generated) return;
    output.focus();
    output.select();
    status.textContent = "Clipboard unavailable. JSON selected; copy it manually and save it as proposal.json.";
  }
});
window.addEventListener("pagehide", () => { if (objectUrl) URL.revokeObjectURL(objectUrl); });
```

`src/scripts/relationships.ts`:

```ts
import { loadKnowledge } from "./knowledge-client";
import { withBase } from "../lib/paths";

const form = document.querySelector<HTMLFormElement>("#relationship-filters");
const graph = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>("#relationship-graph");
const table = document.querySelector<HTMLTableElement>("#relationship-table");
const counter = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>("#relationship-count");
const empty = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>("#relationship-empty");
async function initialize() {
  if (!form || !graph || !table || !counter || !empty) return;
  const { relationships, claims, sources, records } = await loadKnowledge();
  const ns = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
  const names = new Map(records.map((record) => [record.id, record.title]));
  const supported = relationships.filter((edge) =>
    edge.claimIds.some((id) =>
      claims.some(
        (claim) =>
          claim.id === id &&
          claim.citations.some((citation) =>
            sources.some((source) => source.id === citation.sourceId),
          ),
      ),
    ),
  );
  const system = form.elements.namedItem("system") as HTMLSelectElement;
  const entity = form.elements.namedItem("entity") as HTMLSelectElement;
  const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
  system.value = [...system.options].some((option) => option.value === params.get("system")) ? params.get("system")! : "";
  entity.value = [...entity.options].some((option) => option.value === params.get("entity")) ? params.get("entity")! : "";
  function render() {
    const matches = supported.filter((edge) => (!entity.value || edge.fromId === entity.value || edge.toId === entity.value) && (!system.value || edge.fromId === system.value || edge.toId === system.value || edge.claimIds.some((id) => claims.find((claim) => claim.id === id)?.systemIds.includes(system.value))));
    const selected = new Set(matches.map((item) => item.id));
    for (const [index, row] of [...table!.tBodies[0].rows].entries()) row.hidden = !selected.has(supported[index]?.id);
    counter!.textContent = `${matches.length} documented edge${matches.length === 1 ? "" : "s"} shown`;
    empty!.hidden = matches.length > 0;
    const query = new URLSearchParams(); if (system.value) query.set("system", system.value); if (entity.value) query.set("entity", entity.value);
    history.replaceState(null, "", `${location.pathname}${query.size ? `?${query}` : ""}${location.hash}`);
    graph!.replaceChildren();
    if (!matches.length) { graph!.append(document.createTextNode("No sourced graph edge matches these filters.")); return; }
    const vertices = [...new Set(matches.flatMap((edge) => [edge.fromId, edge.toId]))];
    const radius = Math.max(150, vertices.length * 32);
    const size = radius * 2 + 250;
    const center = size / 2;
    const points = new Map(vertices.map((id, index) => [id, { x: center + radius * Math.cos(index * 2 * Math.PI / vertices.length), y: center + radius * Math.sin(index * 2 * Math.PI / vertices.length) }]));
    const svg = document.createElementNS(ns, "svg"); svg.setAttribute("viewBox", `0 0 ${size} ${size}`); svg.setAttribute("width", String(size)); svg.setAttribute("height", String(size)); svg.setAttribute("role", "group"); svg.setAttribute("aria-label", `${matches.length} sourced directed relationship edges`);
    for (const edge of matches) {
      const start = points.get(edge.fromId)!; const end = points.get(edge.toId)!;
      const cited = claims.find((claim) => edge.claimIds.includes(claim.id) && claim.citations.length);
      if (!cited) continue;
      const anchor = document.createElementNS(ns, "a"); anchor.setAttribute("href", withBase(`/claims/${cited.id}`)); anchor.setAttribute("tabindex", "0");
      const source = sources.find((item) => item.id === cited.citations[0].sourceId);
      anchor.setAttribute("aria-label", `${names.get(edge.fromId) ?? edge.fromId} ${edge.type} ${names.get(edge.toId) ?? edge.toId}; evidence: ${cited.statement}; source: ${source?.title ?? cited.citations[0].sourceId}. Open claim`);
      const line = document.createElementNS(ns, "line"); line.setAttribute("x1", String(start.x)); line.setAttribute("y1", String(start.y)); line.setAttribute("x2", String(end.x)); line.setAttribute("y2", String(end.y)); line.setAttribute("stroke", "currentColor"); line.setAttribute("stroke-width", "2"); anchor.append(line);
      const label = document.createElementNS(ns, "text"); label.setAttribute("x", String((start.x + end.x) / 2)); label.setAttribute("y", String((start.y + end.y) / 2 - 5)); label.setAttribute("text-anchor", "middle"); label.setAttribute("fill", "currentColor"); label.textContent = `↗ ${edge.type}`; anchor.append(label); svg.append(anchor);
    }
    for (const id of vertices) { const at = points.get(id)!; const circle = document.createElementNS(ns, "circle"); circle.setAttribute("cx", String(at.x)); circle.setAttribute("cy", String(at.y)); circle.setAttribute("r", "7"); circle.setAttribute("fill", "currentColor"); svg.append(circle); const title = document.createElementNS(ns, "text"); title.setAttribute("x", String(at.x)); title.setAttribute("y", String(at.y - 14)); title.setAttribute("text-anchor", "middle"); title.setAttribute("fill", "currentColor"); title.textContent = names.get(id) ?? id; svg.append(title); }
    graph!.append(svg);
  }
  form.addEventListener("submit", (event) => { event.preventDefault(); render(); });
  system.addEventListener("change", render); entity.addEventListener("change", render);
  render();
}
void initialize().catch((error) => {
  if (graph) graph.textContent = `Graph data unavailable: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}. The sourced table remains available below.`;
});
```

`src/scripts/workspace.ts`:

```ts
import Ajv from "ajv";
import addFormats from "ajv-formats";
import type { KnowledgeDataset, KnowledgeProposal, ValidationRecord } from "../lib/knowledge-types";
import { proposalErrors } from "../lib/proposal";
import { withBase } from "../lib/paths";

const form = document.querySelector<HTMLFormElement>("#validation-form");
const messages = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>("#validation-errors");
const status = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>("#validation-status");
const download = document.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>("#validation-download");
const copy = document.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>("#validation-copy");
if (form && messages && status && download && copy) {
  let revision = 0;
  let prepared: string | null = null;
  let preparedId: string | null = null;
  function invalidate() {
    revision += 1; prepared = null; preparedId = null;
    download!.disabled = true; copy!.disabled = true;
    messages!.textContent = "";
    status!.textContent = "Draft changed. Previous validated output is invalid; validate again before exporting.";
  }
  form.addEventListener("input", invalidate);
  form.addEventListener("change", invalidate);
  form.addEventListener("submit", async (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    const requestRevision = ++revision; prepared = null; preparedId = null; download!.disabled = true; copy!.disabled = true;
    messages!.textContent = ""; status!.textContent = "Validating against the published schema and full catalog…";
    if (!form.reportValidity()) { messages!.textContent = "Complete every required field and select at least one claim."; status!.textContent = "No proposal prepared."; return; }
    const field = (name: string) => form.elements.namedItem(name) as HTMLInputElement | HTMLSelectElement | HTMLTextAreaElement;
    const selected = (name: string) => [...(field(name) as HTMLSelectElement).selectedOptions].map((option) => option.value);
    const claimIds = selected("claimIds"); const sourceIds = selected("sourceIds");
    const buildId = field("buildId").value || null;
    const authorized = (field("authorized") as HTMLInputElement).checked;
    const performedBy = field("performedBy").value as ValidationRecord["performedBy"];
    const authority = field("authority").value as ValidationRecord["authority"];
    const activity = field("activity").value as ValidationRecord["activity"];
    const outcome = field("status").value as ValidationRecord["status"];
    const executedAt = field("executedAt").value || null;
    const textFields = ["environment", "tools", "inputs", "expected", "observed", "bounds"] as const;
    const missing = textFields.filter((name) => !field(name).value.trim());
    const limits = field("limitations").value.split(/\r?\n/).map((line) => line.trim()).filter(Boolean);
    const errors: string[] = [];
    const now = new Date();
    const today = new Date(now.getTime() - now.getTimezoneOffset() * 60_000).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    if (!claimIds.length) errors.push("Select at least one actual published claim ID.");
    if (missing.length || !limits.length) errors.push("Provide a completed execution contract, observed result and at least one explicit limitation; planned results are not observations.");
    if (authority === "reported" && !sourceIds.length) errors.push("Source-reported work requires at least one source revision ID.");
    if (authority === "reported" && outcome !== "reported") errors.push("An author's reported activity must retain the reported outcome; it is not an independently observed pass or fail.");
    if (authority === "observed" && (performedBy !== "observatory" || !authorized || !executedAt || outcome === "reported")) errors.push("Observatory-observed work requires Observatory as performer, explicit authorization, actual execution date and a non-reported outcome.");
    if (authority === "observed" && (activity === "behavior-reproduced" || outcome === "pass") && (!authorized || !buildId || !executedAt || !field("inputs").value.trim() || !field("observed").value.trim() || !field("expected").value.trim() || !field("bounds").value.trim())) errors.push("An observed reproduced/pass result requires authorization, an identified build/sample, execution date, real inputs, expected/observed behavior and bounds.");
    if (executedAt && executedAt > today) errors.push("Execution cannot be dated in the future.");
    if (errors.length) { messages!.textContent = errors.join(" "); status!.textContent = "No proposal prepared."; return; }
    const validation: ValidationRecord = {
      id: `validation-local-${crypto.randomUUID()}`, title: field("title").value.trim(), claimIds, buildId, activity, performedBy, authority, status: outcome, authorized,
      environment: field("environment").value.trim(), tools: field("tools").value.trim(), inputs: field("inputs").value.trim(), expected: field("expected").value.trim(), observed: field("observed").value.trim(), bounds: field("bounds").value.trim(), sourceIds, executedAt,
      reviewedAt: today, limitations: limits,
    };
    const proposal: KnowledgeProposal = { schemaVersion: "2.0.0", validations: [validation] };
    try {
      const responses = await Promise.all([fetch(withBase("/api/v2/schema.json")), fetch(withBase("/api/v2/knowledge.json"))]);
      if (requestRevision !== revision) return;
      if (responses.some((response) => !response.ok)) throw Error("Published schema or dataset unavailable. No proposal can be validated offline.");
      const [schema, existing] = await Promise.all([responses[0].json(), responses[1].json()]) as [Record<string, unknown>, KnowledgeDataset];
      if (requestRevision !== revision) return;
      const ajv = new Ajv({ allErrors: true, strict: false }); addFormats(ajv);
      const validate = ajv.compile({ ...schema, required: ["schemaVersion"] });
      if (!validate(proposal)) { messages!.textContent = `Schema validation rejected the proposal: ${ajv.errorsText(validate.errors, { separator: "; " })}`; status!.textContent = "No proposal prepared."; return; }
      const semantic = proposalErrors(proposal, existing, false);
      if (semantic.length) { messages!.textContent = `Catalog or semantic validation rejected the proposal: ${semantic.join("; ")}`; status!.textContent = "No proposal prepared."; return; }
      prepared = JSON.stringify(proposal, null, 2) + "\n"; preparedId = validation.id;
      download!.disabled = false; copy!.disabled = false;
      status!.textContent = "Validated against published schema and existing IDs. Review the JSON before importing; no catalog change has been made.";
    } catch (error) { if (requestRevision === revision) { messages!.textContent = error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Validation failed."; status!.textContent = "No proposal prepared. Check network or published schema."; } }
  });
  download.addEventListener("click", () => {
    if (!prepared || !preparedId) return;
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([prepared], { type: "application/json" }));
    const anchor = document.createElement("a"); anchor.href = url; anchor.download = `${preparedId}.json`; anchor.click(); setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 30000);
  });
  copy.addEventListener("click", async () => {
    if (!prepared) return;
    try { await navigator.clipboard.writeText(prepared); status!.textContent = "Validated JSON copied. Paste into a local file, then run the importer; no claim state has changed."; }
    catch { status!.textContent = "Clipboard unavailable or denied; use Download validated proposal instead."; }
  });
}
```
